page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.4xlarge is an x86_64 virtualization instance belonging to the High Clock Speed family. It is powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at a base clock speed of 3.1 GHz across 8 physical cores and 16 dedicated vCPUs with hyper-threading enabled. Cache hierarchy allocations include 32 KB of L1 data cache, 1.0 MB of L2 cache, and 35 MB of shared L3 cache. Memory provisioning provides 64.0 GB of RAM, yielding a balanced 4.0 GB per vCPU ratio. The configuration features 5 Gbps of baseline network bandwidth, contains no local storage volumes, and does not include hardware GPU acceleration.

Instruction set support includes AVX, AVX-512 Foundation (avx512f), and AVX-512 Vector Neural Network Instructions (avx512_vnni), alongside hardware cryptographic acceleration via AES. Standard memory and integer extensions such as BMI2, ADX, and FMA are supported, while advanced matrix extensions like AMX are absent. Benchmark evaluations position the instance firmly in the middle tier across compute and memory workloads, scoring 16805.51 on PassMark CPU, 1284.0 single-core on Geekbench, and 7869.0 multi-core on Geekbench. Memory bandwidth measures 90.64 GB/sec for uncached large-block reads and 46.68 GB/sec for writes.

Workload testing demonstrates stable middle-tier throughput for general applications, including 15.39 million operations per second on Redis SET tasks, 12.4 GB/sec static web serving throughput, and single-threaded gzip compression at 25.1 GB/sec. Machine learning inference performance varies by scale: prompt processing for a small 135M model reaches 942.59 tokens/sec, whereas prompt processing on a medium 7B model drops into the lower quartile at 23.22 tokens/sec.

Without integrated local NVMe storage, the instance requires external block storage attachments for persistent state. Given its balanced 1:4 CPU-to-memory ratio, dedicated core allocation, and sustained clock frequencies, ecs.hfg6.4xlarge serves production web architectures, software compilation pipelines, middle-tier enterprise application servers, and in-memory caching nodes requiring stable CPU performance.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.4xlarge is a dedicated compute instance from the High Clock Speed family, powered by a 3.1 GHz Intel Xeon 8269CY processor. It features 16 vCPUs across 8 physical cores, 64.0 GB of system memory, and a 5 Gbps baseline network interface. The instance lacks local storage and GPU accelerators, relying entirely on network-attached storage. Architectural extensions include AVX-512 with VNNI and AES cryptography. Across synthetic benchmarks, the instance yields average performance metrics, demonstrating 16805.51 on PassMark CPU and 7869.0 in Geekbench multi-core. Memory operations achieve 90.64 GB/sec for 256 MB uncached reads, while Redis workloads hit 15.39 million SET operations per second. With a balanced 1:4 core-to-memory profile and high clock rates, the instance fits enterprise web backends, CI/CD compilation, and mid-sized database tiers.
